summary: Delays CHOP channels by a fixed or expression-driven amount, with reset controls that clear the delay cache.

key_params.name: delay
key_params.note: Delay amount, often using me.chanIndex for per-channel delays

key_params.name: reset
key_params.note: Bypass delay and clear delay cache while on

key_params.name: srselect
key_params.note: How mismatched sample rates are handled

key_concepts: Delays each input CHOP channel independently by the Delay amount.
Delay can be varied per channel using expressions such as me.chanIndex or a per-row table lookup.
Delay Unit controls whether the delay value is interpreted as samples, frames, seconds, or another supported unit.
Reset bypasses the delay and clears the delay cache while on; Reset Pulse clears the cache immediately for one action.
Echo-style feedback is not automatic; the official docs point to Delay plus Math chains or Feedback CHOP for echoes.
Sample-rate matching and delay units affect how seconds map to samples, so stable timing depends on deliberate rate handling.
common_gotchas: Long delays on many high-rate channels increase memory and cache cost.
Use me.chanIndex or a table lookup in Delay for per-channel offsets.
Reset clears the delay cache, so output will jump or bypass until the cache rebuilds.
For echoes, official docs recommend chains of Delay and Math CHOPs or Feedback CHOP.
Delay amount units must match the intended timing domain: samples, frames, or seconds.
